# JBMC coverage of the Stage-1 obligations (generated by coverage.py)

status: holds = every declared entry has an expected result, stub audits pass, property and negative-control harnesses exist, and no tracked domain gap remains; refuted-as-expected = additionally the RSKIP reading FAILS as expected while Java's behaviour holds; check = unexpected verdict, unaudited stub, missing control or tracked domain gap (a time or memory stop is not a verdict); pending = no unexpected verdict yet but some entries have no result; missing = no entry.

Six split sentinels have no legal pair and are not extra tested cases. The format3 harness omits third-key deletion; three savedEntries cases overwrite the first key. See [scope reconciliation](../audits/coverage-reconciliation.md) for corrections queued after live batches settle. Findings do not imply exhaustive input coverage.
